title: CDN decision tree for a TAP request
caption: The order of checks from the Visa specification and Cloudflare's 2025-10-24 post. Every failed check after the tag check blocks; a request without a TAP tag falls back to the site's normal bot policy.
alt: Decision tree. If the signature headers are missing, or the tag is neither agent-browser-auth nor agent-payer-auth, the request is not a TAP agent and gets normal bot policy. Otherwise the CDN blocks when a minimum field is missing, when the window is wrong (created must be past, expires future, at most 8 minutes apart), when the nonce was seen in the last 8 minutes, when the key for keyid cannot be found, or when the signature does not verify. If all pass, a browsing tag is allowed as a trusted agent browsing, and a paying tag is allowed as a trusted agent paying, with the merchant checking the body objects.

sourceOfTruth.label: Cloudflare, Securing agentic commerce (2025-10-24), and the TAP specification
